disclosure: Exploratory fixed-frame context diagnostic on previously inspected TUM sequences; not a search over partitions or unseen test data. Absolute paths in design are replaced with portable locations; source design hash refers to the original local artifact.

calibration.source: published TUM fr1 raw RGB calibration

design.selection_rule: per sequence, uniformly select eligible chronological original boundaries; no metric selection
design.metric_rule: decode quaternion/FoV in float64; match names; anchor predictions and GT at the same first shared frame; fit each shared trajectory to the identical GT frames with Sim(3)
limitations: exploratory correlated windows, not independent trials
baseline cache has no RGB-content provenance: caller must supply its matching raw/rectified images
context window order changes the network reference frame; coordinate gauges are removed before scoring
each backend keeps its original preprocessing; cross-backend pixel budgets are not equalized
